info.title: IS domain-bound admission and Nexus decisions
info.description: Explicit opt-in domain profile. Default off; not deployed or activated. Exact registered callback origin selects a verified canonical Nexus domain binding. Legacy choice admission and four Consumer endpoints remain supported; opt-in domain clients must use the new continued-decision contract.

get.description: For opted-in domain clients: The exact pre-registered HTTPS redirect origin resolves the fixed tenant; request Host/forwarded headers and tenant_hint do not choose domain authority. Already-authenticated IS session and existing human Nexus resource grant required. No automatic login resume.

post.description: Separate opt-in contract. Strict POST, canonical IS Host, no cookies, required approved Origin matching domainOrigin, original DPoP resource token and fresh ath-bound proof, receipt digest/generation, domain revision, session/global eligibility, current Nexus policy and operation in one bounded snapshot. Maximum five seconds; no positive cache. Legacy access-decisions rejects explicitly opted-in domain clients with 403 domain_admission_required to prevent downgrade. Other clients are unchanged.

ISSession.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
ISSession.description: Pinned Better Auth HTTPS session cookie in current configuration; authenticate through existing IS login first. Native session validation remains authoritative, no token fallback.

DPoPProof.name: DPoP
DPoPProof.description: Maintained DPoP proof validation; redemption binds sender key, no ath.

HumanDPoP.description: Existing human Nexus resource access token; exact original issuance tied to receipt. Required scope nexus:access:evaluate.

AdmissionReceipt.description: Domain receipt JWT typ=is-domain-admission+jwt, alg=EdDSA; base claims plus exact domain_binding. Expiry <=300 seconds and capped by source human grant, session and transaction. Offline verification is insufficient.

nbf.description: Optional; validate if present. Issuer currently omits it.

AdmissionClaims.description: Decoded signed payload profile only, typ=is-admission+jwt. Validate using pinned maintained JOSE implementation. aud equals target client_id. TTL <=300s bounded by session/authorization. Not a Nexus credential or local permission.

hostname.description: Canonical lowercase ASCII DNS hostname; Unicode provisioned as A-label. No wildcard, trailing dot, IP or port.

origin.description: Exact canonical HTTPS origin, including any registered non-default port. No path, query, fragment or userinfo.

revision.description: Retained monotonic decimal generation, never a JS number.

admissionContext.description: Signed domain admission receipt, not an Authorization bearer token.

domainOrigin.description: Independent expected instance origin; must match Origin, approved binding and receipt.

DomainDecision.description: A positive result requires matching caller/actor/context/profile and an unexpired deadline before local side effects. Domain failure can return 403, eligibility denial 200 allowed=false; unavailable never allows.

x-transition: Existing four live Consumer APIs and their schemas remain supported unchanged. No deprecation date. Admission-aware revocation linkage requires explicit new credential profile; no v1 request-field additions.
x-internal-operations: Identity.admission.validate: online stored receipt and live Nexus policy check; not a public endpoint
Identity.admission.revoke: verified original owner only; revoke receipt and associated legacy human resource issuance atomically
x-feature-gates: existing Identity and Nexus membership gates required
x-release-blockers: No current consumer cutover authorized. Legacy access-decisions does not inspect historical admission policy revisions; full admission-aware continued-access composition remains separately reviewed. Internal validation is not externally exposed. Live browser/native HTTPS acceptance, ledger/grants/backup rehearsal and consumer verification integration required before activation.
